I have grown barley on this small plot for many years. With the land being my own and having some schooling, I know that applying a little chemical fertilizer along with manure helps the barley grow better, though I cannot afford the full recommended amount. I will use my family's labor to work the plot, as hiring workers is too expensive for such a small area, and I have no access to irrigation. I will sow the local barley seed I have saved from last season, as improved seed is hard to find and I do not need chemicals for pests on barley.
